content.comment_body: Hello, does anyone know the maximum switching frequency for the [company_name] [product_name]? I noticed that transistor outputs are limited to around 10Hz. If that's the case, how can we utilize pulse width modulation, though I'm not currently using PWM? I require an output switching frequency of 25Hz—is this feasible with the [product_name]? The input frequency can be up to 5kHz. I'm referring to the [product_name] from the [article_no] family. Thank you, [user_name].
Hello, consider checking [user_name]'s suggestion about using a pulse generator.

Hi, The maximum switching frequency also depends on the cycle time of the [product_name]. The manual outlines how to determine this cycle time. By factoring in both the cycle time and the output's on/off delay (approximately 1ms), you can estimate the highest switching frequency achievable. Regards,
